comparison.objective: Tune a shock absorber vs erect and latch all walls of a folding crate.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-tool insertion and rotary locking vs sequential panel lifting, corner-hook engagement and multi-latch coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming repeated stops with lock retention vs four corners latched, walls vertical and crate released/still.
comparison.reason: Latching is a generic shared concept; crate erection tests articulated multi-panel assembly rather than fine adjustment and dynamic commissioning. Missing rubric detail: two version families differ on whether lifting/tilting is allowed, but both remain clearly distinct.
